effects.effect: As a [free maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/free-maneuver), you can spend 1d6 [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) to ignore a consequence from a [test](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.test/test), or to end one effect on you that is ended by a [saving throw](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.general/saving-throw) or that ends at the end of your [turn](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/turn). Any ally [adjacent](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/adjacent) to you can also spend [Stamina](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.health/stamina) as a [free maneuver](scc.v1:mcdm.heroes.v1/rule.combat/free-maneuver) to gain this benefit.
